outcome: Interval between conception and HIFU treatment
cohort: 28 patients with a history of cesarean scar pregnancy (CSP) treated with HIFU followed by USg-D&C who wanted to conceive following treatment
finding: HIFU followed by USg-D&C is an effective and safe treatment for patients with CSP who wish to conceive, with a high rate of successful subsequent pregnancies.
mod_finding: Of the women who had an intrauterine pregnancy, 12 had delivery by cesarean section.
